title: Zesty Crispy Jamaican Pork Skewers
description: A pungent and crispy Jamaican dish featuring tamarind pulp and a low-carb friendly cure, perfect for adventurous eaters. This recipe combines the bold flavors of Jamaica with a crunchy texture.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a blender or food processor, combine tamarind pulp, coconut milk, soy sauce, brown sugar, scotch bonnet peppers, garlic, and thyme, and blend until smooth.
Place the pork cubes in a large bowl and pour the marinade over them, tossing to coat.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Remove the pork from the marinade and thread onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Roll the skewers in crushed pork rinds to coat, pressing gently to adhere.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and drizzle with a little oil.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the pork is cooked through and the coating is crispy.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
